claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'SONY' and 'PS4' logo only; no body shape, vent pattern, or model label visible to confirm 'Pro' variant vs standard/slim.
No region sticker, plug type, or serial/label visible in the photo to confirm origin/region.
No close-up of console body, vents, or ports to assess cosmetic condition or wear.
No games, discs, or game cases appear anywhere in the reported photo.
Photo 0 shows two sealed/boxed red DualShock 4 controllers stacked on the consoles.

risks.risk: Two consoles are visible stacked in the photo though seller describes only one console for sale, possibly a generic/stock dealer image not of the actual unit.
risks.proof: A fresh photo or video of the single exact console being sold, with a handwritten note/date or seller's phone visible for authenticity.
risks.if_unproven: price as if listing photo is unverified stock image, not proof of actual item condition or count

risks.risk: Console may not power on or function correctly.
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, displaying the PS4 home screen, and running a game or demo.

risks.risk: Storage capacity unknown, affecting value tier.
risks.proof: Photo of console settings/storage screen or rear label showing GB capacity.
risks.if_unproven: price at lowest standard capacity (500GB tier)

risks.risk: No power cable, HDMI cable, or other accessories confirmed included.
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories laid out next to the console.

risks.risk: Claimed 10 games not shown or verifiable.
risks.proof: Photo of the physical game discs/cases or digital library screen.

risks.risk: Controllers' authenticity and working condition unconfirmed (sealed boxes could be resealed or empty).
risks.proof: Photo of opened box showing controller and a video of it pairing/working with the console.
risks.if_unproven: price as unverified/third-party controllers until shown working

risks.risk: PS4 variant (standard vs Pro vs Slim) cannot be confirmed from logo alone, affecting price tier.
risks.proof: Photo showing full body profile including vent pattern and rear ports distinguishing Pro model.
risks.if_unproven: price at standard (non-Pro) tier, the lower-value variant

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the actual console body (top, rear ports, vents) to confirm model variant and cosmetic condition
Video of the console powering on and running a game
Photo of storage/settings screen showing GB capacity
Photo of all included accessories (power cable, HDMI cable) laid out together
Photo of the 10 claimed games (discs/cases or digital library)
Photo of opened controller boxes showing the controllers themselves
A fresh, dated photo proving this specific unit matches the stacked-console image
response.reason: The witness confirms a PS4 console and two controllers exist, so it can be priced at worst case, but the Pro claim, condition, region, games, accessories, and the odd two-console image remain unverified and should be priced conservatively until proven.
